lawha.title: Dashboard

lawha.errId: The post number must be digits only
lawha.errExists: This number is already on the site — edit it from “Recordings”
lawha.errSize: The file is larger than 300 MB
lawha.featuredHint: Shown on the home page. Add one from “Recordings” → open it → tick “Featured”.

lawha.errMedia: Pick an audio file, or add a video or audio link

settings.intro: These settings are saved on their own (not with «Publish changes»); the site updates within a minute or two.
settings.cantSave: Saving needs GITHUB_TOKEN in Vercel (see the guide). You can only look for now.
settings.hijriOffset: Hijri day adjustment for your country
settings.personTitleHint: For example «Ustadh» or «Dr.». Leave it empty to keep the current one.
settings.wordsHint: This is for the main language. Any other wording changes from texts in site.config.json (see the guide).
settings.typesHint: This order is the site's order. An empty name keeps a built-in type's name. Words detect clips from Telegram captions.
settings.homeHint: Tick the sections to show, and order them by dragging or with the arrows.
settings.sheikhsHint: Short names detect clips from Telegram captions. «Weekly» puts the sheikh under weekly lessons.
settings.problems: Some things need fixing before saving:
settings.rebuildHint: After saving, the site updates within a minute or two
settings.saved: Saved ✓ The site will update within a minute or two
settings.changedElsewhere: The settings were changed elsewhere. Reopen this screen and edit again.
settings.githubFailed: Can't reach GitHub ({detail}). You're seeing the settings the site was built with; saving is off until the token is fixed in Vercel.
